# Layers

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Paints child elements in declaration order within the same layout region.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Layers()
new Layers(options: LayersOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`backgroundLayers`](#backgroundlayers): Layers painted behind the primary layer, in declaration order.
- [`foregroundLayers`](#foregroundlayers): Layers painted on top of the primary layer, in declaration order.
- [`primaryLayer`](#primarylayer): The layer that determines the flow height of the stack.

### `backgroundLayers`

```typescript
readonly backgroundLayers: readonly IElement[]
```

*read-only*

Layers painted behind the primary layer, in declaration order.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`. To add one, call `addBackground()`.

### `foregroundLayers`

```typescript
readonly foregroundLayers: readonly IElement[]
```

*read-only*

Layers painted on top of the primary layer, in declaration order.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`. To add one, call `addForeground()`.

### `primaryLayer`

```typescript
primaryLayer?: IElement | undefined
```

*optional*

The layer that determines the flow height of the stack. When undefined, the tallest declared layer defines the height instead.

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
framed.primaryLayer = body;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/financial-dashboard`:

```typescript
layers7.primaryLayer = donut;
```

## Methods

- [`addBackground`](#addbackground): Adds a layer painted behind the primary layer.
- [`addForeground`](#addforeground): Adds a layer painted on top of the primary layer.

### `addBackground`

```typescript
addBackground(element: IElement): Layers
```

Adds a layer painted behind the primary layer. Fluent; returns this.

Example, from `industry-templates/education-public-sector/course-certificate`:

```typescript
framed.addBackground(ornamentalFrame());
```

### `addForeground`

```typescript
addForeground(element: IElement): Layers
```

Adds a layer painted on top of the primary layer. Fluent; returns this.

Example, from `industry-templates/finance-reporting/financial-dashboard`:

```typescript
layers7.addForeground(container6);
```
